editPrefix.description: Rename active threads by replacing the start of their name

removeByPrefix.description: Delete active threads whose name starts with a prefix

nameOption.description: Name of the thread, up to 100 characters

isPrivateOption.description: Make the thread private (text channels only). Default: no

destinationOption.description: Channel to work in; defaults to this channel

prefixOption.description: Only threads whose name starts with this are deleted

create.CHANNEL_CANNOT_HOLD_THREADS: Threads cannot be created in this channel. Pick a text, announcement or forum channel.
create.PRIVATE_NEEDS_TEXT_CHANNEL: Private threads can only be created in text channels!

prefix.CHANNEL_CANNOT_HOLD_THREADS: Threads cannot be listed in this channel!
prefix.noMatch: No active thread in {channel} starts with `{prefix}`.
prefix.NAME_INVALID: the new name would be empty or longer than 100 characters

list.description: Create a private thread for each member in a list or role

byReaction.description: Create a private thread for each member who reacted to a message

prefixOption.description: Thread names start with this prefix, then a dash and the member name

idsOption.description: Member ids or mentions, separated by commas or spaces

roleOption.description: Also create a thread for every member who has this role

messageOption.description: The first message in each thread

destinationOption.description: Text channel to create the threads in; defaults to this channel

messageLinkOption.description: Link of the message whose reactions are used

emojiOption.description: Only members who reacted with this emoji

privateThread.CHANNEL_NOT_TEXT: Private threads can only be created in text channels!
privateThread.noMembers: No member to create a thread for. Give ids, or a role that has members.
privateThread.noReactors: Nobody reacted to that message with {emoji}, so no thread was created.
privateThread.needsIdsOrRole: Give member ids or choose a role.
privateThread.MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: I could not find that message.
privateThread.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: not a member of this server
